hero.description: Modern African architectural marketplace hero background

technical_rules.animations: Framer Motion for page transitions and staggering list items. Hover states should use CSS transitions (transition-all duration-300).
technical_rules.accessibility: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-admin-button'). Ensure high contrast ratio for text over images by using dark/light gradient overlays (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent).
technical_rules.pricing_display: Always show dual pricing: `$15.00 (SSP 15,000)`
technical_rules.form_elements: Use Shadcn customized primitives for selects, dialogs, and tabs, ensuring the rounding and colors match the design system above.

specific_app_instructions.login: Create a clean, centered login page. Hide traditional inputs and use 3 prominent Demo Role buttons (Admin, Seller, Customer) centered in a clean bento-style card.
specific_app_instructions.dashboard_style: Cardless or flat cards with subtle 1px borders, dense data layout, high legibility. Avoid over-using drop shadows in admin views.
specific_app_instructions.verification_logic: In admin and marketplace views, visually distinguish verified shops (e.g., green checkmark badge, top of list) vs pending/rejected.
